title: Wasaw the 42nd
transcription:
Wasaw the 42nd
Split Group

Wasaw the 42nd, Wasaw we none to wa'
Wasaw, the 42nd, marching thru
the brambles raw.
Zoom, we ain't got boots no stockings,
Zoom, we ain't got none to wa'
Zoom, we ain't got boots no stockings,
marching thru the brambles raw.

Zoom, Zoom, Zoom, Zoom.

One half of group sings verse again, while
other half repeats the Zoom as rhythm for
the first group. Switch parts and repeat.

Call-Out-A-Verse Songs
